what_failed: Two of 11 voice subagents (lynch, minervini) failed to produce any valid nomination.json across two spawn attempts each (initial + one re-spawn). Failure text did not match a usage_limit/capacity-ceiling signature (tools/self_heal.py detect_usage_limit) -- both showed a transient tool-output-channel glitch (empty Bash/Read returns), the same class that initially hit wyckoff and elder-lens (who recovered: wyckoff still failed on retry, elder-lens still failed on retry -- see below). seow recovered fully on retry.
degradation_path: Ordinary re-spawn-once path (RB:exceptions, voice failure ladder): re-spawned all 5 problem voices (lynch, seow, minervini, wyckoff, elder-lens) once in parallel with explicit guidance to use Bash/python3 json.load instead of the Read tool on the 791KB universe file. Result: seow recovered (6 nominations). lynch and minervini still produced no output. wyckoff and elder-lens still produced no output on retry (their FIRST attempt had already produced a valid, honest, schema-compliant zero-nomination file with declared data_gaps -- that first-attempt output is being used as their nomination.json for this run, not fabricated as a retry success). Proceeding with the rest per RB:exceptions named_degradations.voice_fails minimum-8 rule: 9 of 11 voices produced valid schema-compliant output this run (7 substantive nominators: raschke, steenbarger, thorp, druckenmiller, oneil, detect-lens, seow; 2 honest-zero: wyckoff, elder-lens). lynch and minervini are empty seats.
state_after: Tally proceeds on 9 voice files; lynch and minervini seats empty; auditor should mark session INCOMPLETE (voice shortfall, ran with 9 of 11).
backlog_item: Engineering & Change: investigate the tool-output-channel glitch affecting isolated voice subagents reading the large (791KB) universe.json this run -- 4 of 11 voices hit empty tool output at least once (wyckoff, elder-lens, lynch, minervini), 2 never recovered even after being told to use python3/Bash instead of Read. Consider a menu-sliced per-voice universe file (D-53 already requires taxonomy-complete, but a smaller per-voice JSON might reduce the failure rate) or investigate sandbox flakiness independent of file size.
